<b>Coordinación y control de calidad.</b: Coordination and quality control. Model federation, clash detection, verification that what is delivered meets what was required, reports at each milestone.
<b>Entorno común de datos.</b> Montado y: Common data environment. Set up and kept in order, with version and access control, without forcing you to buy expensive platforms.
<b>Entregables.</b> IFC, BCF, COBie y me: Deliverables. IFC, BCF, COBie and quantities that come out of the model, not out of a spreadsheet on the side.
<b>Automatización.</b> Las comprobacione: Automation. Repetitive checks are done by a program, not by a person staring at screens. That is why the work comes back in days.
